title: MiniMax Included in the Hong Kong Stock Connect List, Stock Price Rises Over 17% and Attracts Market Attention

content_html:
On August 6, the list of eligible stocks for the Hong Kong Stock Connect was finalized, with AI company MiniMax and several other companies officially added to the list, effective from the same day. Affected by this news, as of the time of writing, MiniMax's stock price had risen by more than 17%, and its market attention continued to increase.

In recent days, MiniMax has been continuously advancing its multi-modal AI technology strategy and open-sourced its new general multi-modal generation model, MiniMax H3. This model ranked first globally in the Artificial Analysis video editing evaluation list and the Arena image-to-video ranking list, demonstrating strong video generation capabilities. At the same time, MiniMax H3 quickly gained popularity on the open-source community Hugging Face, surpassing DeepSeek V4Flash in rankings and becoming one of the most popular models in the community.

Industry experts and AI investors have also given positive evaluations of MiniMax H3. Industry figures such as Emad Mostaque, founder of Stable Diffusion, and Justine Moore, partner at Silicon Valley investment firm Andreessen Horowitz, have publicly shown interest in the progress of this model.

In the capital market, Jefferies recently reaffirmed its "buy" rating for MiniMax and set a target price of 1,118 HKD. Its latest report pointed out that the release of MiniMax H3 further strengthens the company's competitive advantage in the AI video generation field. Meanwhile, with its cost advantages, it is expected to drive enterprise customer expansion and commercialization.

As generative AI moves from model capability competition into application and commercialization stages, AI video generation and multi-modal interaction are becoming key areas in the industry. The inclusion of MiniMax in the Hong Kong Stock Connect also means that its influence in the capital market has expanded further, in addition to its technological breakthroughs.

content_html_zh:
8月6日，港股通合资格股票名单最终确定，人工智能公司MiniMax等多家公司正式纳入港股通股票名单，并于同日生效。 受此消息影响，截至发稿，MiniMax股价已上涨逾17%，市场关注度持续提升。

近日，MiniMax不断推进多模态AI技术战略，并开源了全新的通用多模态生成模型MiniMax H3。 该模型在Artificial Analysis视频编辑评测榜单和Arena图像转视频排行榜中均排名全球第一，展示了强大的视频生成能力。 与此同时，MiniMax H3在开源社区Hugging Face上迅速走红，排名超越DeepSeek V4Flash，成为社区最受欢迎的机型之一。

行业专家和AI投资者也对MiniMax H3给予了积极评价。 Stable Diffusion 创始人 Emad Mostaque 和硅谷投资公司 Andreessen Horowitz 合伙人 Justine Moore 等行业人士公开表示对这一模式的进展感兴趣。

资本市场方面，杰富瑞近期重申了MiniMax的“买入”评级，并设定目标价为1,118港元。 其最新报告指出，MiniMax H3的发布进一步增强了公司在AI视频生成领域的竞争优势。 同时，凭借其成本优势，有望推动企业客户拓展和商业化。

随着生成式AI从模型能力竞争进入应用和商业化阶段，AI视频生成和多模态交互正在成为行业的重点领域。 MiniMax纳入港股通，除了技术上的突破之外，也意味着其在资本市场的影响力进一步扩大。
